title: The sync gate's selectors check misses a test file renamed out of the _tools/test_*.py pattern
goal: Found in the SP-vmxdxtru review: kg_sync.gate_paths lists names with git diff --name-only from the merge base, where a rename shows only the new path, so a test file renamed to a name outside _tools/test_*.py (git mv _tools/test_x.py _tools/old_x.py) leaves no test path in the changed set and gate_needs never runs backlog.py selectors, although the tests a done item's check selects are gone. gate_needs also sees the old path of a rename (git diff --name-status or --no-renames for the test pattern).

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path('_tools/kg_sync.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8');ok='--no-renames' in t or '--name-status' in t;print('gate_paths sees a rename source:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: the defect shows only in a push whose range renames a test file out of the pattern; the repro reads whether gate_paths lists a rename's old path

gates.question: How should kg_sync.gate_paths see the old path of a renamed test file?

notes: Premise (2026-10-08, plan of SP-vayhvwfy): the repro prints 'gate_paths sees a rename source: False', exit 1: reproduces; kg_sync.gate_paths still lists git diff --name-only from the merge base. Gate rename-paths options: no-renames = gate_paths runs git diff --name-only --no-renames, so a rename lists its old and new path and every gate rule keyed on paths sees both (recommended: one flag, no parsing); name-status = parse git diff --name-status and add a rename's source path only, keeping rename detection elsewhere.
